note: Text is copied from the owner's scans of Expansion 1 (the five cut-off cards were rescanned).

cards.name: Sadistic
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to your strongest foe. If they block with a Creature, gain 1 Blood.

cards.name: Auto-Erotic
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each foe. Pay 1 Blood: Choose a foe. They take damage equal to your Blood, and you take damage equal to their Blood.

cards.name: Grubdiddling
cards.text: The foe on your left must give you an Arcane card from their hand OR give you one of their Treasures. Standee: Repeat the effect with the foe on your right.

cards.name: Attackalanche
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to the foe on your right, 2 damage to the next foe on their right, 3 damage to the foe on their right, and so on, until you've damaged each foe once. Pay 2 Blood: Double the damage dealt.

cards.name: Inflamerating
cards.text: The player with the Standee takes 4 damage. If no Living Wizard has the Standee all players take 4 damage. Pay 6 Blood: The player with the Standee takes 8 damage, and then the players to her left and right each take 4 damage.

cards.name: In-Graven
cards.text: Discard any number of cards from your hand that are the same type (Source/Quality/Delivery). Deal damage equal to the number of cards you discarded to a foe of your choice. Pay 4 Blood: Double the amount of damage dealt.

cards.name: Low-Balling
cards.text: A foe of your choice who does not have a Treasure draws a Treasure. Then deal 2 damage to each foe with a Treasure.

cards.name: Burnzerking
cards.text: A foe of your choice must reveal their hand, and then takes damage equal to twice the number of Creatures in their hand. Pay 3 Blood: Choose each foe instead.

cards.name: Gifty
cards.text: Add a Delivery card from your hand to your spell. Pay 4 Blood: Reveal cards from the Main Deck until you reveal a Creature, and then add it to your spell.

cards.name: Woodstalky
cards.text: Discard up to 3 non-Primal cards from your hand. Heal 1 HP for each card you discard.

cards.name: Nonchalant
cards.text: Roll one die and gain that much Blood. If you roll a 4 or less, your weakest foe heals that much HP.

cards.name: Mother-Forking
cards.text: Take the Standee and give it to a foe who didn't already have it. Then deal 3 damage to that foe. Pay 3 Blood: Kill all of that foe's Creatures first.

cards.name: Greedy
cards.text: You draw two Treasures. Each foe who has not acted this round draws one Treasure. Pay 2 Blood: Each foe who has acted this round must destroy one of their Treasures.

cards.name: Pollinating
cards.text: Reveal cards from the Main Deck until you find a Creature, and then add it to your spell. Standee: Add two Creatures instead.

cards.name: Cashed-In
cards.text: Gain a Treasure, and each foe without a Treasure gains one. Pay 8 Blood: Then deal 2 damage to each foe for each Treasure in play.

cards.name: Harvesting
cards.text: Take the Standee and deal 1 damage to each foe for every Dead Wizard. If there are no Dead Wizards, gain 2 Blood.

cards.name: Clonelising
cards.text: Choose one: Either deal 2 damage to each foe with even HP, OR deal 3 damage to each foe with odd HP. Standee: Do both - even first, then odd.

cards.name: Even-Steven
cards.text: Roll two dice. Deal damage equal to the lowest result to a foe of your choice. Pay 2 Blood: Deal the other result to a different foe.

cards.name: Sparkling
cards.text: Deal one die of damage to a random foe. Standee: Then deal 2 damage to a different foe.

cards.name: Infernalucky
cards.text: Each foe must roll one die. The high roller(s) gains 1 Blood—and takes damage equal to their roll. Standee: Each other foe takes damage equal to their roll.
